name: Stakpak Agent
description: DevOps agent for the terminal that can also run unattended, with secret redaction and guardrails around the commands it executes.
whatItDoes: Helps engineers deploy and operate infrastructure from an interactive terminal session or from a long-running autopilot that keeps systems healthy. It can report and take instructions through Slack, Telegram or Discord.
howItWorks: A Rust binary runs the agent loop and substitutes secrets so real values never reach the model. A guardrail layer restricts what the agent may do, and rulebooks capture operating procedures. Tools are served over MCP secured with mutual TLS, and autopilot mode uses Docker.

requirements.name: STAKPAK_API_KEY
requirements.description: Stakpak account key; alternatively log in with your own provider key such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

models: Stakpak hosted models or bring-your-own provider such as Anthropic
